advisor_identified: Historian at the University of Manitoba, then professor at the University of Ottawa, where he taught through 1978.

doctorate.title: The Ukrainian Greek Orthodox Church of Canada, 1918-1951

evidence.says: The Manitoba Historical Society states that Yuzyk completed his history PhD thesis at the University of Minnesota in 1958 on The Ukrainian Greek Orthodox Church of Canada 1918-1951, and was a part-time full professor at the University of Ottawa from 1966 to 1978.

The Canadian Institute of Ukrainian Studies encyclopedia identifies his University of Minnesota PhD as 1958 and records his teaching in history and Slavic studies at Manitoba and Soviet and Eastern European studies at Ottawa through 1978.
The official biography identifies his 1958 Minnesota history PhD thesis as The Ukrainian Greek Orthodox Church of Canada 1918-1951 and records his professorship at Ottawa from 1966 to 1978.

notes: Institution, year, subject and thesis title match linked AHA record 63437; its abbreviated date range 1918-51 is equivalent to 1918-1951.
